policy: no routes deleted in V3.10A; policy is recommend-only

routes.purpose: Read frozen winner models at recorded checkpoints for a served historical race
routes.primary_question: What are the frozen models' winner estimates for this race?
data_shown: season/event selectors, single-vs-ensemble mode, model picker
field table, checkpoint table, probability trend
routes.overlap: PredictionPanel in /replay shows same checkpoint model at replay T; ensemble/checkpoint tables overlap /models evidence rhetoric
routes.scientific_content: independent-binary semantics; checkpoint provenance; ensemble composition
routes.interaction: select season/event/mode/model -> Run prediction -> tab across field/checkpoints/trend
cognitive_load: mode x model matrix exposed up front
three tabs of full-field numbers by default
ensemble vs single distinction is project-internal, not user-asked
routes.future_role: merge into pit-wall selected-driver intelligence; home route becomes contextual deep surface or redirect to /pit-wall

routes.composition: frontend/features/replay/components/ReplayView.tsx (RaceSelector, ContextBar, PlaybackControls, TimelineScrubber, StandingsTable, SpatialTrackPanel, PredictionPanel, ProbabilityTimelineChart)
routes.purpose: Step through a served 2018-2024 race frame by frame with factual states and cached winner checkpoints
routes.primary_question: Where is everyone and what is happening at exact frame T?
data_shown: race selector + factual ContextBar (flag, leader lap, race time, roster, anchor, weather)
routes.overlap: PredictionPanel duplicates / prediction semantics; ContextBar flag duplicates spatial status strip; probability chart duplicates /consensus field content at one T
routes.scientific_content: exact-frame (no interpolation) contract; sparse-checkpoint honesty; independent-binary note; stale-row semantics
routes.interaction: select race -> scrub/play/jump-to-lap -> optional driver select -> checkpoint explanation
cognitive_load: strongest surface: factual-first, single T, transport grouped
weaknesses: standings (7 cols x ~20 rows) + track + prediction + trend all visible at once; anchor-lap vs leader-lap duality; bar widths relative while labels absolute
mobile: standings forces 720px horizontal scroll; scrubber thumb narrow; panels stack vertically
routes.future_role: becomes the pit-wall backbone (replay-as-navigation); keep route as expert/deep-link entry

routes.purpose: Branch stochastic futures from one exact state; report empirical finishing-order frequencies
routes.primary_question: From exact state T, how often does each driver finish in each position over N trials?
routes.overlap: simulation frequencies are the SIM arm of /consensus and /uncertainty; state picker duplicates replay transport
routes.scientific_content: MONTE_CARLO_FREQUENCY contract; support gate (all-clear/dry/contemporaneous); deferred reliability/DNF/points/traffic
cognitive_load: lowest of the workstations; single confusion risk MONTE_CARLO_FREQUENCY vs independent-binary (disclaimed)
routes.future_role: expert-only, navigation-hidden, contextual deep-link (simulation detail behind consensus/uncertainty DETAILS)

routes.composition: frontend/features/consensus/components/ConsensusView.tsx (model panel, simulation panel, disagreement, GapViz, FieldTable, interpretation/provenance)
routes.purpose: Compare frozen Logistic model vs MC2-E simulation at an exact historical state; descriptive disagreement only
routes.primary_question: Where do model and simulation agree/disagree at this state?
data_shown: disagreement summary (leader match/split, top-3 overlap, largest gap, field size)
routes.overlap: field table + GapViz substantially duplicate /uncertainty field comparison (U1); demo anchors duplicate availability logic
routes.scientific_content: probability-family provenance; average-tie ranks; no-blend rationale (fusion research did not improve); refusal states
routes.interaction: pick demo anchor -> read panels -> expand provenance
cognitive_load: highest density: two full panels + summary + viz + dense table + two semantics notes simultaneously
no selected-driver focus; whole field at equal weight
mobile: panels stack; field table hides rank columns on small screens
routes.future_role: expert-only deep-dive; pit-wall shows compact MODEL/SIM/Δ row + DETAILS deep-link

routes.composition: frontend/features/uncertainty/components/UncertaintyView.tsx (field table, driver inspector U1+U2, field telemetry, U3 limitation, context/provenance)
routes.purpose: Report U1 disagreement + U2 finite-sampling precision + U3 simulator-sensitivity limitation at an exact state
routes.primary_question: What is uncertain here, and what kind of uncertainty is it?
data_shown: field comparison table (model p, sim p, signed/absolute gap, ranks, status)
driver inspector (U1 exact + U2 k/n/SE/Wilson + WilsonViz)
field telemetry (Spearman, leader agree, top-3 jaccard, n common)
routes.overlap: U1 field table duplicates /consensus field table; demo anchors duplicate /consensus anchors
routes.scientific_content: three visually distinct uncertainty kinds (never fused); Wilson interval semantics; average-tie ranks; U3 gate/provenance-insufficiency
routes.interaction: pick demo anchor -> select driver row -> read inspector -> expand provenance
cognitive_load: very high: full-field table + 6-stat inspector + interval viz + telemetry + U3 + two semantics notes
only surface with driver selection, but selection is local and page-scoped
mobile: rank columns hidden on small screens; inspector grids 2->3 cols
routes.future_role: expert-only deep-dive; pit-wall shows compact Δ + MC precision line + DETAILS deep-link

routes.composition: frontend/features/strategy/components/Strategy2View.tsx + Strategy2Results.tsx (state strip, precomputed catalogue, setup, results)
routes.purpose: Compare 9 frozen simulated strategy alternatives vs no-intervention reference for one driver at one exact state
routes.primary_question: For this driver at exact state T, how do simulated alternatives differ?
routes.overlap: state picker duplicates replay transport; target picker duplicates selected-driver; results distribution overlaps simulator output
routes.scientific_content: paired 5000-future design; STAY OUT / PIT NOW / PIT NEXT LAP action validity; cache-miss vs unsupported; no-recommendation rule
routes.interaction: select race/state/target/seed/alternatives -> Run comparison (cached) -> read results
cognitive_load: high: 8 facts + catalogue + scrubber + seed-as-identity + 9 alternatives in 3 semantic groups
mobile: facts 2->4->8 cols; setup stacks; scrubber thumb small
routes.future_role: expert deep-dive via contextual EXPLORE STRATEGY entry from selected driver/state; keep V3.6 semantics

routes.purpose: Controlled what-if pit-schedule comparison from a factual state; factual instant, simulation on explicit run
routes.primary_question: From this factual state, how do simulated outcomes change under this controlled intervention?
routes.overlap: state picker duplicates replay transport; availability logic duplicates strategy catalogue; results deltas duplicate strategy matrix rhetoric
routes.scientific_content: simulator-conditional; controlled intervention; no causal alternate-history claim; lifecycle evidence; cache-miss vs unsupported
routes.interaction: select race/decision-point -> build plan -> Run comparison -> read deltas
cognitive_load: highest: factual vs simulated, alt vs base, targets vs items, rival, comparison mode, lifecycle evidence all at once
routes.future_role: expert drill-down via intentional EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE action from selected driver/state
